items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include every bootstrap input in the path gate**

When a PR changes only `.chezmoiroot`, this pattern sets `should_run=false`, so all required public-bootstrap contexts pass without exercising `setup.sh`, even though chezmoi reads that file to select `home/` as its source root. The same omission affects `vendor/compactiondb`, which the included `scripts/update-agent-assets.sh` consumes during bootstrap; either input can therefore break bootstrap without detection until after merge. The closed decision-test row does not cover these actual inputs.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/7779e78b529b87aa52638a20456393f48407d409/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reserve the run before issuing the rerun**

If the process is interrupted after `gh run rerun` succeeds but before the TSV append completes, the ledger still lacks this run ID, so the next invocation passes the check at line 33 and reruns it again; two concurrent invocations have the same race. This violates the script's once-only guarantee, while the closed test covers only two sequential calls after a successful write and therefore does not close this failure mode.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/7779e78b529b87aa52638a20456393f48407d409/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
